title: {{vocab.firm}}: how a {{vocab.payment}} earns trust
subtitle: Your {{cast.agent}} handles claims for you and asks for more trust as the amount and the risk rise. Each rung needs its own proof.

cast.approver: the care app on the member's phone

rungs.name: Visitor
rungs.needs: Reading plan details only. No sign-in.

rungs.name: Member signed in
rungs.needs: A sign-in from {{cast.provider}}, fresh for one hour.

rungs.name: Member verified
rungs.needs: A fresh identity check (5 minutes). {{vocab.payments}} up to 600.

rungs.name: Care-team approved
rungs.needs: An approval from the {{vocab.approver}}, single use, 2 minutes. {{vocab.payments}} up to 1000.

ui.phoneNote: This stands in for {{cast.approver}}. A claim is only released after that app approves it.

outcome.approved: The {{vocab.approver}} approved. Access level 3: submit the {{vocab.payment}} now.
outcome.denied: The {{vocab.approver}} declined the request. The {{vocab.payment}} stays on hold.
outcome.approval_expired: The approval window ended before the {{vocab.payment}} was submitted.
